text: Yes, the 2023 tree-cover loss on this property is confirmed. Earth observation data (Hansen GFC) detected a 4.5-hectare loss within the asset in 2023, which was corroborated by later-year observations and cross-checked against a 2020 forest reference map (JRC GFC2020). The area affected is planted forest (Pinus species), not native forest. The evidence meets the methodology’s requirements for confirmation, though it does not specify the cause or legality of the loss.
